features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: You cast spells from the Sorcerer spell list, using Charisma (full caster, prepared spells). Your magic is innate.

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you empower your magic for 1 minute: +1 to your spell save DC and Advantage on spell attack rolls. Number of uses equals your Proficiency Bonus (per Long Rest).

features.name: Font of Magic (Sorcery Points)
features.desc: You gain Sorcery Points equal to your Sorcerer level. As a Bonus Action, you convert points into spell slots and vice versa; you spend them on Metamagic.

features.name: Metamagic
features.desc: You learn Metamagic options that modify your spells for Sorcery Points. The number you know increases (2 → 3 at level 10 → 4 at level 17).

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.desc: Once per day during a Short Rest, you regain Sorcery Points equal to half your Sorcerer level.

features.name: Sorcery Incarnate
features.desc: When you activate Innate Sorcery, you can also spend Sorcery Points to apply Metamagic to one spell without the usual limits.

features.name: Arcane Apotheosis
features.desc: While Innate Sorcery is active, you can use one Metamagic option per turn without spending Sorcery Points.
